a switched-capacitor dual-slope capacitanced-to-digital converter that operates on the two elements of a differential sensor and provides a dc reference-independent linear digital output is presented and analyzed.
a dual-slope capacitanceto- digital converter (CDC) based on the switched-capacitor technique is presented and analyzed.

we have developed a dual-slope capacitanceto-digital converter that operates on the differential elements of a capacitive sensor, is linearly proportional in its digital output to the physical quantity sensed by the sensor, and is suitable for high-resolution and high-accuracy applications.

a novel switched-capacitor (SC) CDC that is suitable for high-resolution and high-accuracy applications.
the development of a novel capacitance-to-dual-slope converter that is suitable for use in a variety of applications such as the measurement of capacitance, displacement, and pressure.
the design and development of a capacitance-to-dual-slope analog-to digital converter.

a simple and low-cost CDC that is capable of providing a linear digital output for sensors possessing both linear and inverse input-output characteristics can be realized.
